scope: 32 DEV questions, three natural diagnostic arms; 96 new generations; no scoring
observation_limit: Intervals are a single previously completed mixed-case instrumented smoke and include postprocessing between events; they are not per-arm latency estimates and cannot bound other tasks or long generations.
required_before_launch: E1 and PriorTR accepted smoke proof and exit chain
note: The safety bound is intentionally conservative, cannot be presented as projected runtime, and does not authorize execution.
